name: 001-engine-smoke
description: Proves the replay loop end to end: an input triple folds into state and a transcript that are recorded and compared byte for byte. The cartridge is a placeholder with deliberately unsorted keys, so a regression in canonical key ordering fails here rather than in a subtle way later. It also declares no meta.startedAt, which locks the deliberately-wrong 1970 default a cartridge gets for forgetting to; 002-random-clock covers the declared case. Issue #3 replaces it with the minimal fixture cartridge.
